name: Tariq Al-Mansoor
title: Authentic taste of Nizwa and Muscat!
comment: The aroma of pure rosewater, rich ghee, and fresh cardamom took me straight back to Oman. The texture is sublime and the cashews are incredibly fresh. 10/10!

name: Pooja Sharma
title: Tastes just like grandmother's winter kitchen
comment: You can truly taste the pure Gir cow desi ghee and fresh khoya. Not overly sweet, perfectly balanced, and the silver vark on top makes it look fit for royalty.

name: Zayn & Aaliyah Malik
title: The most stunning wedding gift box ever
comment: Ordered 15 boxes for our family gathering. The velvet green packaging with gold ribbon is pure luxury. Everyone was raving about the Karachi jewels and Moong Dal halwa!

name: Dr. Sameer Siddiqui
title: Melt-in-the-mouth perfection
comment: Proper slow-roasted moong dal halwa is an art form. Zaika nailed the consistency, aroma, and generous slivered pistachios. Arrived warm and fresh!
